tips.ja: 右上がり・隙間を開ける
tips.en: Go slightly up to the right. Leave a small gap.

tips.ja: 中心線付近から打ち込んで払う
tips.en: Start near the center line. Make a clear start and move down to the left.

tips.ja: 緩やかにカーブして払う
tips.en: Make a clear start and curve gently to the left.

tips.ja: 中心線の上をまっすぐ下ろす
tips.en: Start near the center line and go straight down.

tips.ja: 中心線上で打ち込んで真下に下ろす
tips.en: Start on the center line. Make a clear start and go straight down.

tips.ja: 斜め下に向かって下ろす
tips.en: Move down to the right.

tips.ja: 全体は逆台形の形
tips.en: Keep the shape wider at the top.

tips.ja: 右上がりに反る
tips.en: Go slightly up to the right and curve slightly upward.

tips.ja: 下の横画は逆方向に反る
tips.en: Curve gently in the opposite direction.

tips.ja: 全体は台形の形
tips.en: Keep the shape wider at the bottom.

tips.ja: 横画は右上がり
tips.en: Go slightly up to the right.

tips.ja: 左端を揃える
tips.en: Keep the left side aligned.

tips.ja: 縦画の書き始めを打ち込む
tips.en: Make a clear start.

tips.ja: 緩やかにカーブする
tips.en: Curve gently.

tips.ja: 1画目より少し短く払う
tips.en: Make Stroke 2 shorter than Stroke 1.

tips.ja: 横画は気持ち右上がり
tips.en: Go slightly up to the right.

tips.ja: 2本の横画は反りを変える
tips.en: Curve Stroke 1 and Stroke 2 in opposite directions.

tips.ja: 2画目のほうを長くする
tips.en: Make Stroke 2 longer.

tips.ja: 直角に交わるように下ろす
tips.en: Cross at about a right angle.

tips.ja: 2つの払いの方向を変える
tips.en: Move the two strokes in different directions.

tips.ja: 払いの向きをずらす
tips.en: Spread the angles of the two strokes.

tips.ja: 横画は少し右上がり
tips.en: Go slightly up to the right.

tips.ja: 横画のほぼ中央から払う
tips.en: Start near the middle of Stroke 2.

tips.ja: 横画は右上がり、縦は内側へ
tips.en: Go slightly up to the right, then move down slightly to the left.

tips.ja: 下の横画を右に出す
tips.en: Make Stroke 2 extend slightly to the right.

tips.ja: 横画の上に出る部分を長くする
tips.en: Make the upper part of Stroke 2 longer.

tips.ja: 3画目のほうを高い位置から始める
tips.en: Start Stroke 3 higher than Stroke 2.

tips.ja: 中心線に向かって払い、中心線で止める
tips.en: Move toward the center line, and finish on the center line.

tips.ja: 2つ目の点を少し左に置く
tips.en: Place the second dot slightly to the left.

tips.ja: 1画目と3画目の始点を縦に揃える
tips.en: Align the start of Stroke 1 and Stroke 3 vertically.

tips.ja: 丸みをつけながら右上に払う
tips.en: Curve gently and flick up to the right.

tips.ja: 横画は短く右上がり
tips.en: Go slightly up to the right and keep it short.

tips.ja: 左右対称の形にする
tips.en: Keep the left and right sides balanced.

tips.ja: 横画はしっかり右上がり
tips.en: Go firmly up to the right.

tips.ja: 打ち込んで中心線より少し左から下ろす
tips.en: Start slightly to the left of the center line and go straight down.

tips.ja: 1画目より少し右に出す
tips.en: Extend Stroke 2 slightly further to the right.

tips.ja: 1画目の点は小さく右下へ
tips.en: Make a small dot moving down to the right.

tips.ja: 枠線の中でバランスを取る
tips.en: Balance both strokes within an inverted triangle.

tips.ja: 1画目と2画目の払いの向きを変える
tips.en: Move the two strokes in different directions.

tips.ja: 上を短く、下を長く交差する
tips.en: Cross Stroke 3 so the lower part is longer.

tips.ja: 最初はまっすぐ下ろす
tips.en: Make a clear start and go straight down first.

tips.ja: 途中から左へ緩やかにカーブして払う
tips.en: Then curve gently to the left and finish lightly.

tips.ja: 2つの点を右上がりに並べる
tips.en: Align the two dots going up to the right.

tips.ja: 上端の高さを揃える
tips.en: Keep the tops of Stroke 2 and Stroke 3 aligned.

tips.ja: 緩やかにカーブして中心線付近で払う
tips.en: Curve gently and move toward the center line.

tips.ja: 2本の横画の反りを変える
tips.en: Curve Stroke 1 and Stroke 2 in opposite directions.

tips.ja: 中心線よりほんの少し右から始める
tips.en: Start slightly to the right of the center line.

tips.ja: 縦画をしっかり打ち込む
tips.en: Make a clear start and go straight down.

tips.ja: 上を短く、下を長く取る
tips.en: Place Stroke 2 so the lower space is longer.

tips.ja: 横画は長めに右上がり
tips.en: Go slightly up to the right and make it long.

tips.ja: 打ち込んで最初はまっすぐ、後から払う
tips.en: Make a clear start, go straight down, then curve gently.

tips.ja: 1画目は短く右上がり
tips.en: Go slightly up to the right and keep it short.

tips.ja: 2画目は逆方向に反らせる
tips.en: Curve Stroke 2 in the opposite direction.

tips.ja: 横画は右上がり
tips.en: Go slightly up to the right.

tips.ja: 左下へ長く緩やかに払う
tips.en: Curve gently and make it longer than the horizontal line.

tips.ja: 直角に近い角度で交差する
tips.en: Cross at about a right angle.

tips.ja: 横画より払いを左に出す
tips.en: Make the curve extend further to the left.

tips.ja: 横画は右上がり、隙間を空ける
tips.en: Go slightly up to the right. Leave a small gap inside.

tips.ja: 左右の下端を揃える
tips.en: Keep the bottom of both sides level.

tips.ja: 打ち込んで緩やかにカーブして払う
tips.en: Make a clear start, curve gently, and finish lightly.

tips.ja: 下端の高さを揃える
tips.en: Keep the bottom of both strokes level.

tips.ja: 2画目を高い位置から始める
tips.en: Start Stroke 2 higher than Stroke 1.

tips.ja: 横画は右上がり、2画目は打ち込む
tips.en: Go slightly up to the right. Make a clear start on Stroke 2.

tips.ja: 横画の上下で高さを均等にする
tips.en: Divide the vertical line into equal lengths above and below.

tips.ja: 2画目の底を真横に長く引く
tips.en: Pull Stroke 2 straight to the right and make it longer.

tips.ja: 横画は右上がり、中心線付近で払う
tips.en: Go slightly up to the right, curve gently, and finish near the center line.

tips.ja: 左を短く、右を長くする
tips.en: Make the left side shorter and the right side longer.

tips.ja: 書き終わりを書き始めより下にする
tips.en: Finish lower than the starting point.

tips.ja: 中央で交差し、縦画を打ち込む
tips.en: Cross in the center. Make a clear start on the vertical line.

tips.ja: 左の点は止める
tips.en: Stop the left dot firmly.

tips.ja: 右の点を左の点より少し高く置く
tips.en: Place the right dot slightly higher than the left dot.

tips.ja: 横画は右上がり、中心線まで払う
tips.en: Go slightly up to the right, then move down to the center line.

tips.ja: 折れの両側の長さを揃える
tips.en: Keep the lengths on both sides equal.

tips.ja: 左右対称の形にする
tips.en: Keep the left and right sides balanced.

tips.ja: 3本の線を平行に引く
tips.en: Pull three parallel strokes down to the right.

tips.ja: 間隔を揃え、3画目を少し長くする
tips.en: Keep equal spaces, and make Stroke 3 slightly longer.

tips.ja: 打ち込んで、強めの右上がりに曲げる
tips.en: Make a clear start, then go sharply up to the right.

tips.ja: 2画目の上下の長さを揃える
tips.en: Keep the upper and lower ends of Stroke 2 equal in length.

tips.ja: 打ち込んで緩やかに払う
tips.en: Make a clear start and curve gently to the left.

tips.ja: 交差した上を短く、下を長くする
tips.en: Cross Stroke 2 so the lower part is longer.

tips.ja: 直角に交わるようにする
tips.en: Cross at about a right angle.

tips.ja: 1画目は上に反る
tips.en: Go slightly up to the right and curve slightly upward.

tips.ja: 2画目を一番長くする
tips.en: Make Stroke 2 the longest horizontal line.

tips.ja: 縦画を少し左から下ろし、下横を短めにする
tips.en: Start Stroke 3 slightly left of the center, and make the bottom shorter.

tips.ja: 横画をしっかり右上がりにする
tips.en: Go firmly up to the right.

tips.ja: 打ち込んで直角に交わるように下ろす
tips.en: Make a clear start and cross at about a right angle.

tips.ja: 折れを斜め下に下ろす
tips.en: Move down to the left after the turn.

tips.ja: 下の横画を下に反らせて長く引く
tips.en: Curve Stroke 2 slightly downward and make it long.

tips.ja: 縦画を少し斜め内側に下ろす
tips.en: Move down slightly to the left.

tips.ja: 下の横画を下に飛び出させる
tips.en: Make the bottom stroke extend slightly down.

tips.ja: 横画は右上がり
tips.en: Go slightly up to the right.

tips.ja: 2画目の横を長くし、中心線で払う
tips.en: Make Stroke 2 wider and finish near the center line.

tips.ja: 1画目をまっすぐ下ろす
tips.en: Go straight down.

tips.ja: 打ち込んで、最初はまっすぐ、後から払う
tips.en: Start higher. Make a clear start, go straight down, then curve.

tips.ja: 両方の書き始めをしっかり打ち込む
tips.en: Make a clear start on both strokes.

tips.ja: 2画目をまっすぐ下ろしてから払う
tips.en: Go straight down, then curve gently and flick up to the right.

tips.ja: 打ち込んで中心線より少し左から下ろす
tips.en: Start slightly to the left of the center line and go straight down.

tips.ja: 丸みをつけて右斜め上へ払う
tips.en: Curve gently and move up to the right.

tips.ja: 左右の縦線を内側に斜めにする
tips.en: Move both vertical lines slightly inward.

tips.ja: 左下と右下をそれぞれ外に出す
tips.en: Make the bottom left extend down, and the bottom right extend right.

tips.ja: 1画目を少し斜め下にする
tips.en: Move down slightly to the right.

tips.ja: 横画は右上がり、丸くしすぎず払う
tips.en: Go slightly up to the right, curve gently, and do not make it too round.

tips.ja: 左端を大体揃える
tips.en: Keep the left side aligned.

tips.ja: 下の横画を長くし、中心線で払う
tips.en: Make the lower part longer and finish near the center line.

tips.ja: 点を右斜め下に打つ
tips.en: Make a dot moving down to the right.

tips.ja: 打ち込んで、丸みを帯びながら右上に払う
tips.en: Start from the bottom left. Make a clear start, curve gently, and flick up to the right.
